notes: Customized KVPAI Portfolio: take the Investor Profile (anchored on analyst consensus) to personalize your KVPAI allocation. New Trade List shows how many shares to buy or sell to reach your targets (rebalance, new cash, or target total), with PDF and CSV export and per-stock ignore. Adjust Allocation hand-tunes the model by theme, category, or stock in percent or dollars, with match-current and locks. Plus per-stock limits. Your allocation syncs across your apps via Google Drive.
